title: Soveraeign Kernel Paradigm Registry (PROPOSED)
description: Resolves the stable Kernel concern names already used by service manifests to the governing source addresses that define them. A paradigm is a coherent slice of Kernel grammar; this registry indexes definitions, it does not replace those sources or ratify their vocabulary.

defines.description: Which dimensions of Kernel grammar this paradigm contributes. This is indexing metadata, not a claim that the listed source files contain nothing else.

sources.description: Repository-relative governing source addresses. Their contents remain authoritative over this index.
